svg.title: Santiago de Compostela Cathedral silhouette
svg.desc: A schematic outer silhouette with two balanced towers and a central peak, without facade details. Cathedral silhouette adapted from Santiago.de.Compostela.Catedral.Noche.jpg by Yearofthedragon, CC BY 2.5, via Wikimedia Commons. Exterior simplified, mirrored for a schematic front view and sampled into one particle outline; all interior details omitted. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Santiago.de.Compostela.Catedral.Noche.jpg License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/
